newsitem.title: GREECE: OTE DEPOSITORY CERTIFICATES AVAILABLE JUNE 25.
newsitem.headline: OTE DEPOSITORY CERTIFICATES AVAILABLE JUNE 25.

text.p: National Bank of Greece , one of the lead underwriters and global coordinators for OTE telecom's 10.7 part-flotation and private placement, said on Monday OTE depository certificates will be distributed June 25.

OTE's private placement calls for a book-building process which will last between June 9-13. Subscriptions for the publicly offered tranche will take place during June 11-13 with an indicative price range to be announced late on June 10.
The issue price will be 200 drachmas lower than the price that will emerge from the book-building process.
The final issue price will be announced on Monday June 16 by the underwiters.

The shares offered to the public will not be entitled to OTE's fiscal 1996 dividend, nor will they include rights to participate in its planned 7.5 percent rights issue which will follow the public offering. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
